messages:
sophia: Heads up: new Dedicated SKU live today and a small region expansion.

sophia: TL;DR: NVIDIA B200 (Blackwell, 256GB, mixed-precision q4_0) is available as Reserved Dedicated in us-central-1 and eu-south-1. We also opened a small H100 warm pool in sa-east-1 for burst traffic.

ops-bot: [system] Inventory: B200-us-central-1: 6 units, B200-eu-south-1: 4 units, H100-sa-east-1 (warm): 5 units. Live counts: /dedicated/inventory

raj: What workloads should target B200 vs GH200/H100?

sophia: B200 is intended for very large memory models and extreme-context lifecycles (>=64k) and large multi-model ensembles. Expect better memory headroom and stable tail-latency under high concurrency. For short-context, H100 still cheaper.

emily: Pricing and procurement notes?

sophia: Reserved multiplier is 2.1x vs A100 baseline. Due to limited inventory, B200 requires an advance capacity request via the Dedicated Capacity flow. Lead times vary 4-10 weeks.

sam: Any changes to routing/fallbacks or SLA guarantees?

sophia: New routing policy "memory_first" added: B200 -> GH200 -> H100 -> A100. You can hard-pin in Console. For Reserved contracts we guarantee minimal availability per region in the contract; warm pools are not SLA-backed.

ops-bot: [system] B200 test cluster enabled. Request via /ops request b200-test {team: <team-name>} (up to 2 seats).

raj: How do I verify scheduling before rolling out?

sophia: Quick CLI check:
```
rw dedicated check-capacity --region us-central-1 --gpu B200 --model /models/ultra-128k
```
If AVAILABLE you can proceed. FALLBACK responses will include recommended alternate configs.

emily: Can Sales start talking to customers yet?

sophia: Sales + Finance notified. Please use the internal KB for TCO examples; public changelog after legal review. Will post perf snapshots tomorrow.

sam: Thanks! Booking a B200 test slot for our long-context QA. :rocket:
